problem: Increase API throughput without degrading consistency
key_problem: All reads hit the primary database

contradictions.administrative: Higher throughput is required under fixed infrastructure
contradictions.technical: If caching increases, throughput improves but freshness may degrade
contradictions.physical: Data must be cached for fast reads and not cached when freshness is critical

ifr: The system serves fast reads and refreshes only when required by data risk

concepts.name: Risk-aware event invalidation
concepts.mechanism: Cache stable data; bypass or synchronously invalidate critical objects
concepts.test: Replay change events and compare stale-read rate, throughput and cost
